identification: Two framed Bea Maddock 'Red Text' prints (Genesis text, etched zinc, red ink on handmade NZ flax paper, waxed, Ritchies Mill Launceston 1984), numbered XXV and XXVI of a 40-work series, with typed artist statement. Plus a pen drawing of a man with umbrella and bag, a small circular etching in brick-pattern frame (signed in pencil, dated 79?), and a pen and wash tram scene signed Colin Crichton (uncertain).

viewing_check: Check the edition numbers XXV and XXVI and signature or title on the Red Text prints and their backs, and that the typed statement is attached. Photograph the signature and date on the small circular etching (79?) and the signature on the tram scene (Colin Crichton?), and the umbrella drawing for any signature. Check the paper for foxing, stains or damage under the glass. Check whether the small chairs etching is signed Samek.
